description.value:
Frequency once per day

A fragment of the Choir itself arrives: a single undead entity of your level −2, not a minion, acting on its own initiative and broadly aligned with your intent. It isn't yours; it's visiting. Casting this always draws the Choir's Toll.

cinderfall.incomplete: An independent-actor summon is the same unmodeled-actor-creation class as raising an Afflicted. Raising/creating a new minion or ally creature (P-SUMMON) has no system.rules representation. Real pf2e itself ships rules: [] for the equivalent case (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/spells/spells/rank-1/summon-undead.json, system.summons left unpopulated too), but per this pass's own convention that is evidence of the gap, not license to treat the clause as correctly-empty -- it is dispositioned INCOMPLETE, not SKIP. The Choir's Toll random table (TOLL) is referenced by roughly ten cards in this class. No rule element models rolling on a GM table, or substituting a chosen result for a roll -- zero precedent searched or expected, this is squarely outside anything system.rules can represent.
